feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Christa Pike is walking with help and eating after failed execution attempt
entry.summary: Pike has begun walking and eating again at a hospital a week after surviving Tennessee's attempt to execute her with lethal drugs, her attorneys said Thursday.

entry.title: Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed
entry.summary: The Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the execution would be "public.

entry.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln returns home to San Diego Bay
entry.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned home after a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea supporting the Iran war. The extended deployment drew attention following reports of crew stress and supply shortages.

entry.title: The USS Abraham Lincoln is home in San Diego, after a record deployment
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Rep. Sara Jacobs, D-Calif., about the return of the USS Abraham Lincoln, after some 11 months away from its home base in San Diego, including support in the Iran War.

entry.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln is returning home to San Diego
entry.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln is returning home to San Diego Thursday after supporting the Iran war during a record long deployment of 265 uninterrupted days at sea that included reports of deteriorating conditions among its crew.

entry.title: New U.S. indictment charges former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro with torture
entry.summary: U.S. authorities added new torture charges to their case against former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, ramping up pressure on the ousted authoritarian leader already fighting drug trafficking allegations.

entry.title: 4 people on NASA's Crew-12 mission return to Earth after 8 months in space
entry.summary: Four people — two NASA astronauts, one from the European Space Agency and a Russian cosmonaut — spent nearly eight months at the space station, conducting spacewalks, science experiments and research.

entry.title: People along the Gulf Coast prepare for Hurricane Isaias
entry.summary: Isaias became the first hurricane of the Atlantic season late Wednesday. It's expected to make landfall along the U.S. Gulf Coast Friday.

entry.title: Teen arrested for alleged shooting plot at the Mall of America, authorities say
entry.summary: Federal prosecutors say a teenager is under arrest, under suspicion of plotting a mass shooting at Minnesota's Mall of America.

entry.title: ICE has quietly used this warehouse as a detention facility all summer, neighbors say
entry.summary: Throughout the summer, rumors have been bubbling in North New Jersey that ICE has quietly been using a warehouse as a detention center. NPR investigated.
